data.name: Dur
data.gender_notes: Dur is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'durr' meaning 'oak tree' or 'durable'. In Old Norse, it means 'hill' or 'fortress'. In the context of Christianity, Dur symbolizes strength and protection. The name Dur carries the meaning “Fortress, Stronghold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dur usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, stronghold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing spiritual fortitude and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Dur belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortress, Stronghold.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dur total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
